key_points: Positive Phase 3 win for dazodalibep in Sjögren's disease is a genuine pipeline catalyst from the Horizon Therapeutics acquisition.
Stock already rallied ~4.34% on the news, pricing in much of the immediate upside.
Analyst consensus remains 'Hold' — price targets raised but no upgrades, with Citi flagging 'open questions.'
GuruFocus flags the stock as ~7-9.6% overvalued, tempering enthusiasm.
Dazodalibep needs to clear a second late-stage trial and FDA review, so full value remains unrealized over a multi-month horizon.
